audit.whatIsWrong: Row 3 is marked Skill while whys[3] says 'She keeps the edge', and row 4 is marked Skill while whys[4], spikes[2] and the mid text all call level 6 'my single best window in the entire matchup'. Header also says EVEN 6/10 for a 40% matchup where Poppy owns six of seven rows.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Poppy / Nautilus / Poppy / Poppy, which matches the prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Row 3 to Poppy and row 4 to Nautilus in both layers as one atomic group; difficulty raised to HARD 8/10.

audit.why: Spikes are her level 2-3 W window, her level 3 full kit, your level 6 Depth Charge, and her first bruiser item. Ladder is right and now agrees with the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict is described only as something that knocks you out of an all-in. The page never says it is a channel, so the player never learns they can cancel it.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict is a channelled hammer strike on a 140/120/100s cooldown. Any hard CC lands during the wind-up, so Dredge Line's pull, Staggering Blow's root or Depth Charge cancels the whole ultimate — the single most valuable thing Nautilus can do against Poppy, and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — hold a CC for it and your hook or ultimate cancels the knock-back outright.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json (R: channel 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', untargetable, cooldowns)

audit.whatIsWrong: Two claims run through this page that Riot's text does not support, and I could not verify either: (a) that Steadfast Presence grounds Dredge Line mid-flight and cancels the pull, and (b) that Hammer Shock deals percent-CURRENT-health damage.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence's text says it stops enemy DASHES; Nautilus's Q carries projectile, knockup, hardCC and terrain flags and is not tagged a dash, so whether Poppy's W denies the hook — and whether it denies only the terrain self-pull or the enemy pull too — is not answerable from the kits. Hammer Shock's text is 'damage and creates a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay' with no percentHealth flag anywhere in Poppy's kit; the page's own phrasing 'percent-current-HP' is also the wrong denominator for any historical version of the ability.
audit.corrected: LEFT ALONE per the do-not-speculate rule. Both claims are recorded in unverified and raised in questionsForUser rather than rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in the first person ('my passive root', 'I bait her W out', 'I don't win a sidelane 1v1 here'). Every other matchup on this champion uses second person.
audit.why: Voice break the reader will notice immediately.
audit.corrected: Not rewritten here: those three fields also carry the two unverified mechanical claims above, and rewriting them would restate claims I cannot source. Flagged for a follow-up pass once the W-versus-hook question is answered.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 8/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Heroic Charge and how you use your level 6.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Poppy carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Poppy carry threat 7/10.

edits.after: Her first bruiser item plus E-wall-stun out-trades you, though Keeper's Verdict is a channel any CC of yours cancels.

notes: Two claims on this page are asserted confidently and cannot be sourced from the kits, so they were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than guessed at: that Steadfast Presence grounds Dredge Line mid-flight (Poppy's W stops dashes; Nautilus's Q is not flagged a dash), and that Hammer Shock deals percent-current-health damage (no percentHealth flag exists in Poppy's kit and Riot's text mentions none). Both need a ruling before the early/mid/late fields can be safely rewritten. Separately, early, mid and late are written in the first person and break the site's second-person voice — deferred to the same pass for the same reason. Kit-file flag misfire: Hammer Shock (Q) is tagged 'grounding' with no grounding in Riot's text. Added value this pass: Keeper's Verdict is a channel your CC cancels, which the page never told the player.
